title: Desert Frequencies
subtitle: A little louder, a little later.
alt: A guitarist under red club lights, with a small audience gathered close to the stage.
heading: Find your place near the speakers.
lead: An evening of local live music, warm amplifiers and unhurried sets. Come early for the opening act and stay for the sounds you did not know you needed.
inclusions: Three live sets from local musicians
Standing room close to the stage
A full evening of music on one ticket
know: This is a standing-room show. Bring hearing protection if you prefer a quieter listening experience.
The evening is 21+. Photo identification is required. Set times are approximate.
attendance: Advance admission is $18 in this sample listing. Check the organizer’s ticket page for availability, fees and refund terms before making plans.

title: The Late Set
subtitle: Good company. Questionable stories.
alt: A stand-up comedian holding a microphone in a small, warmly lit room, with the audience seated in front.
heading: A small room. A good laugh.
lead: Settle in for a late-night lineup of local comics and new material. An intimate room, a relaxed host and enough time for one more story.
inclusions: A hosted lineup of local comedians
know: Seating is first come, first served. Arrive before the show to sit with friends.
Expect adult language and themes. This is a 21+ evening. Please keep phones silent during the sets.
attendance: Admission is $15 in this sample listing. Confirm tickets and the venue’s cancellation policy with the organizer before heading out.

title: Ink After Dark
subtitle: A printmaking social.
alt: Hands rolling ink at a shared printmaking table, surrounded by prints, tools, and a coffee mug.
heading: A different kind of night out.
lead: Carve a simple block, pull your first print, and settle into an easygoing evening around a shared studio table. Make something imperfect and entirely yours.
inclusions: Your finished prints to take home
schedule: Meet the table & choose a design
Ink, roll & pull your first print
know: Beginners are welcome. Wear something you’d happily get ink on. Come on your own or bring a friend; everyone shares a worktable.
This is a 21+ evening. Arrive about 10 minutes early to get settled.
attendance: The $32 workshop price includes materials and one drink. A real listing would link to the organizer’s booking page here, with availability and cancellation terms.
